channel.title: Blog feed (including updates)
channel.description: Blog posts sorted by last update — updated articles re-appear when revised.

item.title: Running CNC and Laser on TwoTrees TTC450 with FluidNC
item.description: How I replaced the stock GRBL-ESP32 firmware on a TwoTrees TTC450 with FluidNC, enabling instant CNC/laser switching via YAML config without touching esptool again.

item.title: Run Windows 11 on Linux with QEmu Nested Virtualization
item.description: How to set up a QEmu/KVM virtual machine on Linux with nested virtualization support for running Windows 11 and WSL2, including VirtIO drivers, HyperV configuration, and disk management.

item.title: Replacing the spark plug of a Palazzetti Lara pellet stove
item.description: After years without replacement, the igniter on a Palazzetti Ecofire Lara stopped firing. This post covers the fault diagnosis without opening the stove, the correct replacement part, and the replacement procedure.

item.title: Installing a CR-Touch on a stock CR-10S
item.description: How to wire a CR-Touch to the stock CR-10S mainboard using a DIY adapter cable, patch Marlin 2 firmware, and calibrate the probe offset.

item.title: Tracking hot water tank power consumption with PowerCalc in Home Assistant
item.description: Estimate hot water tank energy consumption in Home Assistant with PowerCalc by combining a binary trigger and a voltage-aware power template.
